subject: HealthPrime: third-party roster & SIG evidence roadmap
messages:
From: Marcus Lee <security@healthprime.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@healthprime.com
Date: 2026-01-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Third-party roster & SIG/CAIQ evidence request

Hi Neha,

We're kicking off the vendor assurance pack for HealthPrime's pilot with Redwood. Our procurement and security teams need a concise third-party roster plus completed SIG/CAIQ artifacts to finish our initial assessment. Specifically we need: 

- A complete roster of subprocessors (name, country, brief role, whether they have direct data access)
- Completed SIG questionnaire or equivalently mapped CAIQ responses
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted OK) and any relevant encryption/KMS residency details (which regions, who manages keys)
- Any network/dataflow diagrams or short notes on where customer data may traverse third parties

Ideal timeline: can you provide an initial evidence packet within two business weeks? If not, please propose milestones. Also flag any items that are sensitive and require an NDA or secure transfer channel.

Thanks — we want to keep the pilot schedule intact.

Marcus Lee
Head of Security, HealthPrime
marcus.lee@healthprime.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lee <security@healthprime.com>
Cc: procurement@healthprime.com
Date: 2026-01-09T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Third-party roster & SIG/CAIQ evidence request

Marcus — thanks for the clear ask. We can put together a scoped evidence packet and aim to deliver an initial bundle by Monday, Jan 12, with follow-ups as needed. Proposed plan: 

1) Subprocessor roster CSV (fields: name, service, country, access type, contact) — preliminary export attached as redwood_subprocessors_20260110.csv
2) SIG/CAIQ mapping — we will attach a completed SIG answers PDF and an exported CAIQ matrix (redwood_caiq_matrix_20260112.xlsx)
3) SOC2 Type II — we will provide a redacted copy (soc2_type2_redacted_2025.pdf). If you require a non-redacted copy, tell us and we'll route through secure transfer + NDA.
4) Key management & residency — short summary included in the SIG attachment; keys are customer- or platform-managed depending on plan (we'll indicate which for your account).
5) Links to a shared Drive folder and a HubSpot deal for tracking.

Please confirm if HealthPrime's compliance team needs (a) full raw SIG export or (b) a summarized Q&A. Also confirm whether the roster should include contractors and subcontracts beyond our normal subprocessor list.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwoodHealthPrimeEvidence
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234560/deal/4982

We'll escalate internally to get SOC2 redaction approved and to populate all fields.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-10T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: HealthPrime evidence — action items

Forwarding HealthPrime request and plan — action items below. Keeping this thread internal so we have a single source of truth.

Marissa: please own the SIG/CAIQ artifacts and packaging. Deliverables: redwood_sig_answers_v2.pdf and redwood_caiq_matrix_20260112.xlsx. Make sure each question has a short evidence pointer (e.g., 'logs retained in Datadog, retention policy doc link'). Aim to hand off to Neha for review by EOD Jan 11.

Grace: own KMS/residency confirmation. For HealthPrime we must explicitly state which regions host customer KV and who holds root key. Provide a short one-page summary and confirm whether any subprocessor has KMS access.

Attachments to prepare (stubs for now): subproc_inventory_20260110.csv (canonical roster), redwood_sig_answers_v2.pdf (SIG Q&A), soc2_type2_redacted_2025.pdf (redacted report). Use Drive folder above and flag anything with elevated sensitivity that needs DocuSign/NDA or an encrypted transfer.

HubSpot deal: HP-4982 — update stage to 'Security Review' and add the evidence packet link.

Thanks — Neha
